## What and why

Paper A's healthy-control addendum (PR #54, record `docs/research/records/2026-10-24_paper_a_v03c_controls.json` on `research/paper-a-v0.3`, key `app_dis`) ran the device's own DIS code on 100 public healthy controls:

- the raw automatic FLAMeS 5-fold segmentation marked at least one lesion in **85/100** healthy brains (2.6 per scan);
- the app's brain dissemination-in-space (DIS) rule was **met in 19/100** (95 % CI 11.8–28.1 %; 22/100 with a single fold);
- **63 %** of the false marks were periventricular.

Limits of that evidence: one site (SibBMS), template-normalised images, controls not read by an expert ("lesion-free" assumed), licence CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 (no number is quoted in any product text for that reason), one segmenter.

On `main` @ `70cc5c7` the DIS route computed DIS on **any** loaded segmentation; nothing read the existing review record (RC-047). This PR makes DIS an output of a **confirmed** segmentation only, on every path. Problem report: `docs/iec62304/records/problem_reports/PRB-003_DIS_Evaluated_On_Unreviewed_Segmentation.md`; CAPA: `docs/iec62304/records/capa/CAPA-016_DIS_Requires_Confirmed_Segmentation.md`.

### How an unreviewed automatic mask reaches DIS today (verified in code; production config not read)
- **Open now:** `POST /segmentation/create` + `PUT /segmentation/{id}/mask/binary` accept any mask (e.g. another AI program's output) into a segmentation with no provenance; it is indistinguishable from hand-drawn work and DIS is computed on it. Hand-drawn segmentations have no record of who checked them.
- **When the flags are on:** server tools (LST-AI, FLAMeS worker, SynthSeg, mindGlide; `*_ENABLED` default false) store `segmentation_type=automatic` with **no** provenance, so they could never even be confirmed; an unreviewed in-browser FLAMeS draft (`VITE_ENABLE_BROWSER_FLAMES`, absent from the tracked `.env.production`) is evaluated like any mask.
- **Also:** classify-regions stored a DIS result for any mask and the viewer showed it straight from the metadata; the AI report forwarded a client DIS block and printed "NOT MET" for a missing flag; the AI assistant restated the route's result.

## What changed

**RC-070 — DIS only on a confirmed segmentation (REQ-SAFE-038; HAZ-008, HAZ-005, HAZ-003)**
- `backend/app/services/dis_review_gate.py` (new): a confirmation counts only if bound to the SHA-256 of the **current** stored mask (region labels included) — AI draft: the RC-047 review (reused); any other segmentation: the new clinician confirmation (RC-071). Otherwise the explicit state `evaluation_status: "not_evaluated"` ("Not evaluated: requires clinician review of the segmentation", reason, origin) with **no** `dis_met*`, region presence or topography count.
- `segmentation_analysis.assess_dis` (shared by the DIS route and the report route): gate first; nothing computed or cached when not confirmed; a stored block served only if it was evaluated and the gate passes now.
- `segmentation_regions.classify_regions`: stores the gated state (a reclassification changes the mask and voids an earlier confirmation).
- `segmentation.get_segmentation` / `list_segmentations`: metadata responses never carry `analysis_data.dis_assessment` (stored records are not rewritten).

The backend test suite can never reach a real cloud service: five independent layers in `backend/tests/conftest.py` (forced missing credentials file, empty gcloud configuration, offline project and removed service keys, `google.auth.default` always refuses, sockets loopback-only incl. Windows' asyncio proactor) | Local test runs with developer credentials wrote **62 test accounts into the production user store** (112 writes, 2026-07-12..10-24; encrypted with the public test key, unusable to sign in; no patient data) | PRB-002; not safety-related; no Class C module touched. ### What changes for the user
- The sign-in page has **no Register tab** and says "Accounts are created by an administrator". The server refuses
  self-registration (404) unless `SELF_REGISTRATION_ENABLED` is set on a **non-production** server; `GET /api/v1/auth/registration`
  (public) states the policy; **`POST /api/v1/auth/users`** lets an administrator create an account with its role.
- Each user sees **only the patients of their care team** in the patient list and search (administrators: all).
- A clinician who creates a patient **is put on its care team** and can open it; the access log gives the true reason.
- The administrator sees and manages accounts created at any time (no restart).
- Deleted studies and documents are **no longer listed or counted**; "SEGM." shows the real number (or "—");

- The segmentation author is **the person who created it** ("Author not recorded" for older ones); **one set of initials**

> **DRAFT — PENDING owner approval. Do not merge. Code review required** (CLAUDE.md: this changes how Class C image and
> mask data are presented; no module of the Class C list is modified — `edgeAI.worker.ts` untouched).

## What changed and why

A real-browser capture session of the release candidate (`release/owner-signoff-2026-10-25` @ `6d1fde2`) found six display
problems; the coordinator added a seventh (region colours, PRB-010). Each one was reproduced on `main` @ `70cc5c7` by a test
written **before** the fix (commits `b37049e`, `e06d876`, `11ec425`), then fixed (`fcab367`, `68b49bb`, `af0275a`). None of them
is specific to the release branch.

| Finding | Problem report | What was wrong on `main` | Fix | Requirement / control |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| F16 | **PRB-004** (Critical, safety, HAZ-006) | W/L GPU 2D view laid the slice out by the scanner affine: rotated 90° (and possibly mirrored) against the Standard view where the mask is edited; slider between two slices; masks of another grid/voxel order drawn by their own affine | GPU view gets the Standard view's layout (`utils/niivueVoxelGrid.ts`) for image **and** mask, voxel-centre slice; mask only on the image's own grid + RC-031 order, else not drawn and stated | REQ-SAFE-041, RC-073 |
| F01 | **PRB-005** (Major) | 3D and GPU views crash with "reading 'toUpperCase'" on a host without a dot (`localhost`, intranet names) | every volume gets an explicit NIfTI name; the views pass the bytes | REQ-FUNC-101 |
| F02 | **PRB-006** (Major, safety, HAZ-001/007) | mask NIfTI kept the MRI's `cal_min/cal_max` and niivue used it: red fog in 3D, lesions nearly invisible | fixed range on every niivue mask overlay; stored mask gets its own range | REQ-SAFE-042, RC-074 |
| F05 | **PRB-007** (Minor) | 2x2 grid "No image assigned" for a study of preprocessed images only; 4th panel empty with two T1w | fall back to the images the study has; fill spare panels | REQ-FUNC-102 |
| F15 | **PRB-008** (Minor) | every image opened on slice 1 (outside the head) | middle slice; kept within one study only on the same voxel grid; grid panels likewise | REQ-FUNC-103 |
| F18 | **PRB-009** (Minor, HAZ-004 lowered) | unshipped `brain_screening.onnx` requested at every viewer opening, button shown while looking | Quick Screen behind `VITE_ENABLE_QUICK_SCREEN` (off); one lookup per page; button only when served | REQ-FUNC-104, RC-075 |
| region colours | **PRB-010** (Major, safety, HAZ-005) | region overlays and zone legends drew PV red / JC green / IT blue / DWM gold while the lesion legend is Okabe-Ito | one mapping `utils/regionColors.ts` read by every legend and overlay; backend stores the same colours | REQ-SAFE-043, RC-076 |

## Independent review of this PR (@ `39f9d44`) and two film-capture findings — fixed

Every item reproduced first by a test that fails on `39f9d44`
(`docs/iec62304/records/risk_verification/PRB-004_review_tests_on_39f9d44_2026-10-28.json`); details in PRB-004 §9 and the

| **M1** | 3D drew the lesion mask and both visit masks by their own affine with no check (legacy masks mirrored, identity-fallback masks misplaced, silently); `GET /segmentation/{id}/nifti?ref_file_id=` raised `NameError: io` and would have stamped the image's affine on any same-shape mask | route realigns **only** a mask whose stored affine IS the image's (legacy transpose undone by the RC-031 marker), serves it with the marker and its own range, any other mask unchanged; GPU and 3D request masks with `ref_file_id`; 3D draws a mask only with the marker and a scanner position, else a notice names it and why. Resolves D-3 (legacy masks on the image's grid are drawn again in the GPU view) |
| **M2** | unsaved segmentation / unsaved edits silently missing from the GPU and 3D views | stated on screen (`hasUnsavedEdits` from `ImageViewer2D`) |
| **M3** | 3D "go to slice" = index/(depth−1) on the axial axis (wrong level; wrong axis for sagittal/coronal storage) | voxel → mm → niivue `mm2frac` on the axis along which k advances |
| m1 | colour-blind claim measured on opaque colours; as drawn (36 % over grey) IT vs DWM ΔE 5.3 for deutan | **deep white matter vermillion #D55E00**; as drawn worst pair ΔE 9.1 (tritan), 9.8 deutan, 14.3 normal; claim corrected; test checks the drawn colours |
| m2 | later visit white in 3D ("hot" top) | red |
| m3 | niivue's own keys / wheel / double-click changed slice or window behind the store | off; wheel steps the store slice |
| m4 | slice kept on a switch whenever the slice count matched | kept only on the same reported voxel grid |
| m5 | GPU notice at the top, under the identity block in a narrow view | bottom centre; **measured in a real browser** (headless Edge) — which caught that the first fix touched the two-line laterality caveat |
| m6 | GPU and 3D drew region-classified masks all red | label colours (regions: the shared mapping), unlisted values cyan |

All earlier findings verified fixed by the re-review. Its new items, each reproduced first by a test that fails on `4626d17`

Coordination with PR #69: no confirm logic here; the unlabelled-value colour is the constant above.

**For the merge with #69** (`release/owner-signoff-2026-10-25`):
- `UNLABELLED_FALLBACK_COLOR` is defined twice — in #69's `frontend/src/utils/drawnLabels.ts` and in #71's
  `frontend/src/utils/regionColors.ts`. Keep ONE definition (`'#00FFFF'`) and re-export it from the other module; #69's texts

pull_requests.title: data(registry): Ljubljana open_ms licence is non-commercial (CC BY-NC-ND)
pull_requests.head: data/ljubljana-licence-nc
pull_requests.body:
## What and why

`data/registry.yaml` listed the Ljubljana 3D-MS-DB (Lesjak et al. 2018, `open_ms_data`) as **CC-BY**. The lab's official page says **CC BY-NC-ND** (checked 2026-10-28); only the GitHub mirror says CC-BY. Until the lab confirms otherwise, the data is treated as **non-commercial**: academic papers only, never product calibration, thresholds or marketing. The entry is corrected.

## Follow-up found while checking (not changed here)

- `frontend/src/services/flames/contrastGate.ts` (`FLAIR_GATE`, version `flair-gate/2`): its content thresholds were **fitted on MSLesSeg, open_ms_data and ISBI-2015**. The FLAMeS in-browser feature is behind a flag that is OFF, but the shipped thresholds derive partly from non-commercial data (open_ms) and from ISBI-2015 ("challenge terms"). Before the feature is ever enabled in the product, the thresholds should be re-fitted on commercially usable data only (e.g. MSLesSeg, CC BY 4.0) or the licences confirmed in writing. Owner decision.
- The first app film's review cuts used Ljubljana sub-13 screens; they were never published, and the film was paused.

No code change, no deploy. Owner decision: confirm the licence with the Ljubljana lab, or keep the non-commercial treatment.

pull_requests.title: Next safety round: geometric-fallback gate, AI-draft confirm gate, grid mismatch, overlay opacity (PENDING owner approval)
pull_requests.head: fix/next-safety-round
pull_requests.body:
**DRAFT — PENDING owner approval. Do not merge, do not deploy.** Four items the owner accepted as "fix in the next version", each its own problem report (next free numbers on every branch: PRB-028..PRB-031, RC-090..RC-093, REQ-SAFE-044..047; documents continue from SRS 1.17 / RMF 1.19 / TM 1.16). Branch from `main` @ `ca600c2`.

| Item | Problem report | Requirement | Risk control | Hazards |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Geometric fallback feeds DIS without a per-lesion review | PRB-028 | REQ-SAFE-044 | RC-090 | HAZ-005, HAZ-008 |
| AI-draft review confirmed with no drawn-lesion check | PRB-029 | REQ-SAFE-045 | RC-091 | HAZ-001, HAZ-003 |
| L1 — Confirm over an image of another grid | PRB-030 | REQ-SAFE-046 | RC-092 | HAZ-006, HAZ-008 |
| L2 — zone map / longitudinal overlay can camouflage lesions | PRB-031 | REQ-SAFE-047 | RC-093 | HAZ-005, HAZ-008, HAZ-007 |

## What changes for the radiologist
- **Geometric fallback (PRB-028).** Evidence: on MSLesSeg P51 the geometric fallback labelled 42 of 45 lesions periventricular and agreed with the MSMask atlas on 11 of 45 (`mstool-film/assets/app-captures-p51/data/`, app outputs, not expert labels). When the regions come from the geometric fallback, the DIS card now lists every lesion left at its geometric region with "open slice N" and a tick; **Confirm stays off until every lesion is ticked** (or relabelled by hand — then it is a region correction, acknowledged as before). The server refuses the confirmation without the digest of the ticked list, and always above 100 such lesions. A confirmation recorded without the per-lesion check no longer makes DIS evaluable (`geometric_regions_not_reviewed`; the card offers the confirmation again). Atlas / parcellation / LST-AI classifications: unchanged. The Class C classifier `ms_region_classifier.py` is **not modified** (gate at route/viewer level, as for the < 3 mm³ removals).
- **AI-draft review (PRB-029).** The check that already guarded the DIS confirmation now guards the AI-draft review too, from ONE shared module (`frontend/src/utils/confirmDrawCheck.ts` — the DIS card's code was moved there, not copied): Standard 2D view, one panel, segmentation mode on, every value drawn with the label stored on the server (read when Confirm is pressed), visible, overlay on, lesion opacity ≥ 25 %. Refusals are listed in the banner. The server compares the drawn label table (same function as the DIS route).
- **Image grid (PRB-030, L1).** Both confirmations are refused while the image under the mask is on another grid (the viewer compares columns/rows/slices with the mask; the server reads the image header: shape, affine within the RC-039 tolerance, **same study** — on MNI data every visit shares one grid), or when that cannot be told.
- **Layers under the lesions (PRB-031, L2).** Both confirmations are refused while the zone map is above **30 %** or the longitudinal overlay (55 %), FLAIR subtraction heat map (60 %) or conformal tiers (78 %) are shown. A stored zone-map opacity above 30 % is not restored in a new session. The 2D longitudinal overlay no longer draws persistent green against new red: persistent yellow #F0E442, resolved blue #0072B2, new reddish purple #CC79A7 (Okabe-Ito, used by no region or lesion label — changed after the review, it was the deep-white-matter vermillion; worst pair ΔE76 12.9 as drawn for normal/deutan/protan/tritan vision, was 12.2, 9 required).

**Proposed threshold (owner decision): 30 %.** A layer of opacity a over the image leaves (1 − a) of the image contrast and of the lesion colour's own contrast inside an area of the same colour; at 30 % at least 70 % remains. 30 % is the zone map's default, so the default never refuses.

## Verification
- **Failing first.** `5f4d9cc` adds the tests only; on `ca600c2` backend 32 of 37 and frontend 42 of 49 fail, the rest are positive controls (`d494367`). After renaming the tests after their controls (`7dd0977`, manifest gate) the record was re-run with the sources of `ca600c2` restored: backend 32 of 37, frontend 38 of 43 fail (`05cdf37`, `records/risk_verification/PRB-028-031_tests_on_base_2026-10-31.json`).
- **Suites** (offline per PRB-002, no cloud credential): backend unit **2346 passed**; frontend **671 passed, 3 skipped** (`--pool=threads`); `tsc --noEmit` clean; `vite build` passes.
- **Negative controls** (`scripts/safety/prb028_031_negative_controls.py`, throwaway worktree, refuses uncommitted targets, restores on signals): **49 of 49 mutations detected** (RC-090 14/14, RC-091 5/5, RC-092 19/19, RC-093 11/11; baseline and restored runs green; throwaway worktree of `05cdf37`, removed after the run) (`records/risk_verification/PRB-028-031_negative_controls_2026-10-31.json`).
- **Fixtures, no assertion removed:** the PRB-003 test classification record says `msmask` (those tests keep testing their own rule); confirmation requests state the image under the mask; the AI-draft tests seed the draft drawn on screen; four exact-argument assertions also name the new argument; `drawnLabels.digest.test.ts` checks the new request fields.

## Documents (all DRAFT, PENDING owner approval — no approval line written)
PRB-028..PRB-031 (`docs/iec62304/records/problem_reports/`), SRS-001 1.18 (REQ-SAFE-044..047), RMF-001 1.20 (§3.10 causes, RC-090..RC-093), TM-001 1.17 (addendum), `rc_test_manifest.json` (RC-090..RC-093, 88 controls; the manifest gate passes).

## Deployment order (when the owner decides)
Hosting (viewer) first, then the backend: an older viewer does not send the image under the mask or the AI-draft drawn table and the new backend would refuse its confirmations.

## Residual risk
The drawn-lesion, grid and layer checks run in the browser; the server checks what the client states it drew (label table, image under the mask, ticked list) — a direct API call can state them without drawing (RMF-001, residual risk of RC-071, now also RC-090..RC-092).

## Owner decisions (PENDING)
1. Severities: PRB-028 Major, PRB-029 Major, PRB-030 Minor, PRB-031 Minor.
2. PRB-028: the per-lesion tick as the "explicit review" (instead of refusing DIS on every geometric classification), with its **usability cost for native-space clinical images** (every lesion ticked — 45 for P51; more than 100 lesions cannot be confirmed on a geometric classification; a parcellation or MNI registration avoids it). Ticks are cleared when the segmentation is closed or the page reloaded.
3. PRB-028: whether the P51 figures (MSLesSeg data) may be quoted in the interface (texts now say only that geometric regions "often differ from the atlas").
4. PRB-030: the same-study condition.
5. PRB-031: the 30 % threshold; that the longitudinal overlay, subtraction heat map and conformal tiers refuse Confirm whenever shown; the longitudinal colours (yellow / blue / reddish purple).
6. Independent code review: `dis_review_gate.py` and both confirmation routes decide what a Class C result may rest on.
7. Raise GitHub Issues for PRB-028..PRB-031 (SPR-001); record the approvals yourself.

## Independent review of `290e407` — corrections (2026-10-31, PENDING owner approval)
No blocker, no major; the four claims hold. 10 minor findings, fixed on this branch with the same process: tests first (`77770b6`; on `290e407` backend 6 of 7 and frontend 7 of 12 fail, the legend test file cannot load, the rest are positive controls or regression tests — `f6eddce`, re-run with the sources of `290e407` restored in `26d8436`), then the corrections (`114e32d`), then the negative controls re-run.

| # | Correction |
|---|---|
| m1 | "Colorize by zone" (switched on with the zone map) refuses both confirmations unless every value is a region 1-4 drawn with its region label (it does not draw values 5/6 and paints 1-4 in the region palette whatever the label) |
| m2 | A tick only while THIS segmentation is open and drawn, and only after its "open slice"; ticks cleared on close / switch / changed list; PRB-028 §4 corrected |
| m3 | Honest limit written into RMF RC-090: a tick shows the slice was put on screen, not that it was read; a client can echo the served digest |
| m4 | Geometric binding compared only while geometric lesions exist (an atlas re-run on the same mask keeps the confirmation) |
| m5 | Ticks keyed by first voxel + region; regression test and negative control for the reset |
| m6 | Longitudinal "new" → reddish purple #CC79A7 (no region or lesion label uses it; pairs still pass the colour-blind checks). **Also found:** a legend already existed in the comparison result and still showed the former blue/green/red after this PR's first round — it now takes the canvas's colours (neutral CAPA-013 words kept) |
| m7 | A request without the drawn table or the image under the mask → "This viewer is out of date … reload" (both routes) |
| m8 | Recorded in PRB-030 §4 (study = visit; path convention) |
| m9 | Image header read from a byte range (`download_file_range`, ranged GCS read) instead of two whole images |
| m10 | Recorded in PRB-028 §6 (corrections above 100, atlas default DWM, history event) |

**Suites:** backend unit **2381 passed**; frontend **677 passed, 3 skipped**; `tsc` clean; `vite build` passes. **Negative controls:** **62 of 62 mutations detected** (RC-090 18/18, RC-091 9/9, RC-092 21/21, RC-093 14/14; throwaway worktree of `5cc88b9`; a first re-run was stopped when R3 went undetected behind the new out-of-date answer — a direct test of the grid check was added) (`PRB-028-031_negative_controls_2026-10-31.json`, throwaway worktree).
